content:
watchOS 27 is the latest major software update for Apple Watch, which adds several new features and three brand new apps to your watch.

#1: Siri

Siri has received a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, one part of which is the brand new Siri App.

The Siri App is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 still allows you to wake Siri via the Digital Crown, but this App provides an additional place for you to start a conversation. More importantly, this App is where you can browse through your past conversation history.

Siri AI is more conversational than the old assistant, and will record past queries across all your devices. Therefore, the Siri App on watchOS 27 will not only show conversations from Apple Watch, but also from other devices like iPhone and Mac.

#2: Find My

To complement the new features brought to the Find My App in iOS 27, Apple has also reimagined the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My was split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple has consolidated all Find My functionality into one brand new unified "Find My" App.

Find My on Apple Watch offers all the features of the previous three apps, but with a more streamlined experience, allowing you to easily locate any object or person through a map-centric interface.

You can use the menu in the top left corner to switch between different things you want to find, otherwise the interface remains consistent.

#3: Readiness

If you own an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 will also add a third app: Readiness.

Below is a brief introduction to the Readiness App's features from the App Store:

The Readiness App analyzes your recent activity, vital signs, and sleep data to help you understand your capacity to cope that day. Features include obtaining a score and a clear status category, namely Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It. View explanations of relevant factors and tap to jump to the relevant App. New complications and Smart Stack widget for at-a-glance information. View more details in the Fitness App on iPhone.

In short, Readiness gives you a quick overview of your overall vital signs, so you know how rested and prepared your body is for the day.

What are your thoughts on the brand new Apple Watch apps in watchOS 27? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
